class.name: PS3SystemUtil
class.description: Exposes lightweight PSL1GHT system utility helpers for on-console messaging. Requires [code]sysUtilCheckCallback()[/code] to run each frame (handled automatically by the PS3 platform main loop).

method.name: poll_message_async
method.description: Polls an async dialog opened by [method show_message_async]. Returns [code]0[/code] while open, [code]1[/code] when closed, [code]2[/code] when aborted, [code]-1[/code] when no dialog is active.

method.name: show_message
method.description: Shows a blocking system message dialog on PS3 hardware or emulator.

method.name: show_message_async
method.description: Opens a non-blocking message dialog. Poll with [method poll_message_async] each frame.
